entities.name: Étienne Cabet
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Étienne Cabet was a philosopher and utopian socialist who founded the Icarian movement. Cabet became the most popular socialist advocate of his day, with a special appeal to artisans who were being undercut by factories.
